contractSummary: Bootstrap one minimal Cloudflare Pages preview environment using a least-privilege token. Store credentials only as GitHub Actions Secrets and keep production separate.
task: Create the dedicated preview Pages project, configure least-privilege Cloudflare credentials in GitHub Actions, perform the first deployment, and verify the stable preview without exposing credential values.
sanitizedDiff: External configuration only. No credential value, account identifier, private URL, personal data, or source photo is included in this bundle.
evidence: The active Cloudflare token has only Pages Write permission for the selected account and expires after one year.
Two superseded tokens were revoked after a browser capture exposed one token during setup.
A uniquely named replacement token was created, confirmed, and stored in GitHub Actions Secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.
The account identifier is stored in GitHub Actions Secret CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID.
The non-sensitive project name is stored in GitHub Actions Variable CLOUDFLARE_PAGES_PROJECT.
Cloudflare token validation returned an empty Pages project list before creation.
The course-homework-preview Pages project was created and 15 built files were uploaded successfully.
The stable preview URL returned the visible application identity and navigation.
The temporary local token file was deleted after GitHub Secret update and deployment.
No production project, production workflow, custom domain, or family photo was created or uploaded.
